69:t_1:88.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Oh... You're here too, $$レド$$. Perfect timing.」

69:t_1:90.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yeah. We're having a party now.」

69:t_2:4.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...I just noticed, $$レド$$... Have you gotten a little tan?」

69:t_2:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I've been help-ing load and un-load cargo outside... these past few days.」

69:t_2:6.en:
$$レド$$
「...Though I wasn't much use. $$チェインバー#pilot$$ did almost every-thing on its own...」

69:t_2:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But your language skills have gotten a lot better, too. Now you can live on the fleet without any trouble.」

69:t_2:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well, I'll... go get some meat.」

69:t_2:10.en:
$$エイミー$$
「We only eat beef and pork on special days aboard the fleet, so let's eat plenty!」

69:t_2:12.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$ガロード$$ and everyone in $c... They're leaving, aren't they?」

69:t_2:16.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I heard the $$人類銀河同盟$$ was fighting $$サイデリアル$$, too...」

69:t_2:17.en:
$$レド$$
「This is... just one re-mote planet... My fight-ing here alone would mean no-thing...」

69:t_2:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Sep-a-rat-ed from my unit... I'm no longer needed...」

69:t_2:19.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Because you can't fight for the Alliance?」

69:t_2:22.en:
$n
「But there are people who need you... People who treasure you.」

69:t_2:24.en:
$n
「Yeah... Mind if I join you for a bit?」

69:t_2:25.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I'd be happy to have you.」

69:t_2:27.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... The other day, you said people who aren't useful aren't needed.」

69:t_2:29.en:
$n
「I wonder who decides whether someone is useful...」

69:t_2:31.en:
$n
「...There was a child once... He got caught up in all sorts of incidents and shut himself off completely...」

69:t_2:32.en:
$n
「He'd been living with his mother, but after the incidents, his father, who lived apart from them, took him in...」

69:t_2:34.en:
$n
「...To his father, he must have seemed hopeless...」

69:t_2:35.en:
$n
「He barely answered, no matter what his father said. He never did anything on his own, just sat in a corner hugging his knees...」

69:t_2:36.en:
$n
「But his father never abandoned him. Do you know why?」

69:t_2:40.en:
$$レド$$
「Even though he was no use at all?」

69:t_2:41.en:
$n
「That was for his father to decide. ...He trained the child out in nature and kept sharing his thoughts with him.」

69:t_2:42.en:
$n
「The child did his best to keep up. His heart was torn to shreds, but I suppose he wanted to live...」

69:t_2:44.en:
$n
「You've only known battle, so you might not understand. But that's another way of living...」

69:t_2:45.en:
$n
「And now that you're separated from the Alliance, you have to decide how to live for yourself.」

69:t_2:46.en:
$n
「Of course, $$エイミー$$ and all of us intend to help you do that.」

69:t_2:48.en:
$n
「Who knows... I'm sure everyone has their own reasons.」

69:t_2:49.en:
$n
「That's all I have to say. Stay with the fleet, or come with us... You're the one who has to choose.」

69:t_2:50.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Please wait. What happened to that child in the end?」

69:t_2:51.en:
$n
「A lot's happened since then, but he's doing well. He's been blessed with good friends and people around him.」

69:t_2:53.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Hey, $$レド$$. Just like that child had his father, I have my sister.」

69:t_2:55.en:
$$ベベル$$
「My sister needs me... You've survived this long because someone needed you too, haven't you?」

69:t_2:56.en:
$$レド$$
「Be-cause I was useful as a sol-dier...」

69:t_2:57.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then, the other way around... Isn't there anyone you feel you need?」

69:t_2:58.en:
$$ベベル$$
「My sister and I need each other. And above all, I need myself. That's why I live.」

69:t_2:59.en:
$$レド$$
「...But there is no pur-pose in a useless being's sur-vi-val...」

69:t_2:60.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then what's that hanging at your waist?」

69:t_2:61.en:
$$レド$$
「This is... a $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fang. I re-cov-ered it after a battle and keep it as a per-son-al possession.」

69:t_2:62.en:
$$ベベル$$
「My sister told me you were drilling holes in it and making something.」

69:t_2:64.en:
$$ベベル$$
「It's a flute, isn't it? You don't need that in battle at all...」

69:t_2:66.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Let me borrow it a moment.」

69:t_2:67.en:
$$ベベル$$
「If you blow into it like this...」

69:t_2:71.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$レド$$, what's wrong? Are you crying?」

69:t_2:74.en:
$$レド$$
「No... It's just... some-thing in my head...」

69:t_2:75.en:
$$レド$$
「I was... much smaller than I am now... That was... The child with me was...」

69:t_2:76.en:
$$ベベル$$
「You remembered something sad, didn't you...?」

kept_omissions: 69:t_2:63: deliberately trails off rather than name his activity.

context_decisions: The child in Hibiki's account is Hibiki himself, established by his story and Ledo's recognition at 69:t_2:52, so male pronouns restored.
69:t_2:24 asks to join their conversation, then Bevel welcomes him.
Ledo speaks fluent Alliance language via Chamber when discussing the useless being at 69:t_2:59; no artificial accent added there.
